about.title: Join the Community-Led Tech Conference
about.subtitle: DevFest Windsor is a community-led technical conference hosted by the Google Developer Group (GDC) Windsor. It's a premier local event designed to bring developers together to learn, connect, and build the future.
about.description: Whether you're a seasoned developer or just starting your tech journey, DevFest offers something for everyone. Experience inspiring talks, hands-on workshops, meaningful networking, and exclusive swag.
about.experienceSubtitle: Four amazing things await you at DevFest Windsor 2026
about.talksDesc: Learn from industry leaders and Google Developer Experts about the latest technologies, best practices, and innovation in web, mobile, cloud, and AI.
about.workshopsDesc: Hands-on sessions covering Web, Mobile, Cloud, and AI. Get hands-on experience and learn skills you can apply immediately.
about.networkingDesc: Connect with fellow developers, startup founders, tech enthusiasts, and industry professionals. Build meaningful relationships in the tech community.
about.swagDesc: Get exclusive DevFest gear, enjoy great food and drinks, participate in activities, and celebrate with the community at our amazing after-party.
about.readyText: Secure your spot at DevFest Windsor 2026 and be part of the tech community's biggest event of the year.

venue.title: Event Venue
venue.description: Join us at the beautiful University of Windsor campus, conveniently located in the heart of Windsor, Ontario.
venue.gettingHereDesc: The University of Windsor is easily accessible by car and public transit. Located on Sunset Avenue, just minutes from downtown Windsor and the Detroit River.
venue.parkingInfoDesc: Visitor parking is available in Lot H and the Assumption Parking Garage. Rates are $10/day. Campus maps available at information booths.
venue.publicTransitDesc: Transit Windsor routes 1C, 2, and 11 stop directly at the campus. Check transit.windsor.ca for schedules and real-time updates.
